items.title: Rev 2 · Every creature starts the encounter with its AP
items.do: Put Aveline, Kaela, an Orc Warrior and a Goblin Sneak in a combat and start it. During the orc's turn, look at Aveline's and Kaela's portraits in the HUD's party strip and at the combat strip at the top.
items.expect: Everyone starts with its AP (4; the goblin 3), no Reaction Point diamond anywhere. The Strike slashes (3) show for every creature on both strips, its turn or not; a Strike Kaela makes as a Reaction in the orc's turn takes one.

items.title: Quick Shots, Lay On Hands, Consecrated Ground (the review)
items.do: Sylwen uses Quick Shots on the Orc Warrior (force a Tier 1 and a Critical with the dialog's Flat if needed); Aveline uses Lay On Hands (1 AP) on Kaela; Durgan (level 2) places Consecrated Ground and Kaela starts her turn in it.
items.expect: Quick Shots' Tier 1 deals [V] 1d6! + Mod, there is no Evade after it, and on a Critical a "Basic Attack" button makes one free Basic Attack (no AP spent). Lay On Hands gives Guard 4 + Aveline's Power Modifier. Consecrated Ground gives Kaela Guard 2 + Durgan's Power Modifier.

items.title: Rev 2 · A Doomed caster gives Favored Saves
items.do: The Orc Warrior uses War Howl with Aveline and Sylwen in the area: open its roll dialog and add 2 Banes and 1 Boon with the buttons, then use it. Then use War Howl again with Doomed on.
items.expect: The Save Action's dialog has Boon, Bane, Favored, Doomed and Empowered buttons and Boons and Banes rows. The first time, each target's Save has "Caster's Banes" +1 (2 Banes and 1 Boon leave 1). The second, each target's Save is Favored ("Caster Doomed").

items.title: Rev 2 · Slip Away and Backhand: an enemy ends its turn adjacent
items.do: Kaela has Slip Away and a Dagger as well as her bow. The Orc Warrior ends its turn adjacent to her; use Slip Away. Then do it again on another round and press Cancel on the granted use.
items.expect: Once the orc's turn has ended, Slip Away is offered; Use starts her Evade 1 by itself, and her HUD shows a granted "Interact" (0 AP, from Slip Away) to swap weapons; using it costs no AP. Cancel skips it and removes it. Backhand (Durgan ending his turn next to the Ogre Chieftain) still works as before.
